_provenance.note: CMYK values are the authoritative brand builds. The hex values are the sRGB rendering of those CMYK builds as produced by poppler (pdftoppm -r 150) and are used for screen/HTML only. Do not treat hex as the brand definition.

charcoal.role: Primary field / all display and body type on cream

derived._note: Not in the brand book. Derived for this piece only, by darkening the named flavor colour until cream type clears 4.5:1. Each carries the flavour it was derived from so the relationship to the brand is traceable.

rule_gold.role: Hairline rules and frames ONLY. Never body copy on cream (2.4:1).

muted.role: Sampled from the brand book's own caption type.

typography._substitution_notice: The three brand faces are licensed and no font files exist in the Colvard Drive. All three are substituted with metrically comparable SIL OFL faces. This is a visible deviation from the brand book and must be signed off before print, or the art rebuilt in InDesign with the licensed faces.

display.substitute_rationale: Termina is a wide geometric grotesque. Archivo's width axis reaches a comparable set width; tracking and 95% horizontal scale are reproduced directly in CSS.

body.substitute_rationale: Pragmatica is a Helvetica-lineage neo-grotesque; Archivo Narrow is the closest OFL condensed neo-grotesque and shares a superfamily with the display face.

script.substitute_rationale: Alkaline is a connected, slanted monoline brush script (it sets 'Handcrafted' and 'Sausages' inside the logo lockup). Caveat Brush is the nearest OFL brush face. The match is the weakest of the three - it is unconnected where Alkaline connects. Used for one accent line only; the logo lockup carries real Alkaline as vector outlines, so the mark itself is unaffected.

primary.conversion: pdftocairo -svg; all 143 path fills rewritten to currentColor so one file serves both polarities
primary.note: Type inside the lockup is already outlined, so no font dependency.
